description: Represents the timestamp of the environmental measurement, recorded at regular intervals.
Indicates a measured concentration, potentially of atmospheric particles or a specific pollutant, without explicit units provided.
Represents the absorption coefficient of Black Carbon (BC) at a wavelength of 637 nm.
Represents the total aerosol absorption coefficient at a wavelength of 637 nm.
Measures the aerosol scattering coefficient at a wavelength of 450 nm.
Measures the aerosol scattering coefficient at a wavelength of 525 nm.
Measures the aerosol scattering coefficient at a wavelength of 635 nm.
Represents the Ångström exponent, indicating the wavelength dependence of aerosol optical properties.
Represents the Single Scattering Albedo (SSA) at a wavelength of 637 nm, indicating the fraction of total extinction due to scattering.
Denotes the total particle concentration measured by a Scanning Mobility Particle Sizer (SMPS) instrument.
The total measured volume of a substance or sample, represented as a numerical value.
The calculated average diameter of particles or objects within a sample, represented as a numerical value.
